mesh_refresh_correction.existing_parent: PR #156 Live fusion re-entry: causal worker feedback bus v1
incremental_gap_after_refresh: one active lease per logical work item
idempotent effect key across retry or restart
mesh_refresh_correction.coordination_decision: Treat this candidate as a stacked work-ownership extension of PR #156, not a competing live-fusion bus.

hypothesis: Combining the existing causal live-fusion re-entry bus with one-active-work leases, monotonic fencing, current spec revision checks and idempotent effect keys reduces duplicate/stale work under retry, crash and failover conditions.
counterhypothesis: PR #156 plus current mandatory refresh/revalidation is already sufficient; lease/fencing state adds coordination and SQLite cost without material additional benefit.

repo_gap.observation: Several open UnifiedDB EAP dispatch issues use repeated dispatch surfaces. This demonstrates retry/re-dispatch possibility only; it is not proof that the underlying benchmark executed redundantly.

external_mechanism_refs: Apache Kafka idempotent producer and fencing/recovery concepts

covered: one active lease across two SQLite connections
lease expiry failover increments fence epoch
same effect key with conflicting result rejected
restart preserves fence and effect receipt

limitations: Synthetic parameters are assumptions, not production measurements.
Zero duplicate/stale effects in the model follows from assumed correct fail-closed/idempotent implementation and is not a live guarantee.
No successful Hostinger/Ubuntu receipt exists yet for the lease extension.
No Work Event or PR #156 replacement/promotion is authorized.
Real SQLite contention, clock/expiry behavior and scheduler integration costs remain unmeasured.
required_next_tests: parent PR #156 plus lease extension differential
crash after operation before effect receipt
lease expiry and old-holder late commit
latency CPU RAM busy/lock and write amplification
Ubuntu self-hosted differential against parent live-fusion and current work-event runtime
promotion_rule: Candidate remains a stacked shadow work-ownership extension until matched Ubuntu differential and recovery/resource tests show net incremental benefit over PR #156 plus current revalidation. NO_BENEFIT, KEEP_ISOLATED and REFUTED are valid outcomes.
